title: When the Winter Falls
author: Theo Eastwick
blurb: Freya Sandoval, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
